issues: Sales reached target despite falling week on week and year on year (KPI meeting 10/11).

Delivery sales dipped because of teething problems with the new Too Good To Go surplus sushi trial; orders placed when there was no waste had to be cancelled, which led to negative customer reviews, and Ka Ho asked for the trial to run for a month to gather data before deciding (KPI meeting 10/11).
Wages were slightly over target because of an unannounced EHO inspection, and an admin training was completed (KPI meeting 10/11).
Food and drinks variances were stable, and the site posted a positive stock variance without using any count edits (KPI meeting 10/11 and Admin Meeting 09/11).
Google reviews: ten 5 star and one 3 star.
Delivery prep and rider wait times rose slightly; tickets bunch after 8pm, and with printer problems, early drivers and reduced weekday staffing, prep times go over 15 minutes.
Menu pictures stay on delivery because over 300 deliveries were refunded last week across the sites and the pictures help with disputes.
Food cost against revenue is acceptable, and hygiene checks, the waste log and the Kobas rotas are complete.
Site compliance was 95%, there are no open maintenance jobs after Ka Ho rebuilt chairs from broken parts, and the canopy replacement is postponed until January.
A Deliveroo partner hub login update is waiting on Ross (KPI meeting 10/11).

Book tour editor event next Wednesday from 6:30pm: 19 tickets sold, all dishes to be served at once, an extra sushi chef and kitchen staff from 5pm to 9pm, six FOH plus bar, and stickers have arrived but posters have not.
Before the event the sushi bar needs a 1 to 1.5 hour deep clean and the kitchen an extra 30 minutes of cleaning on Tuesday night, with an extra FOH closer added.
Christmas menu: apple gyoza is popular but duck ramen has not sold; M8 is also missing its cookbooks (KPI meeting 10/11).
